items.title: Residential proximity to oil and gas development and socioeconomic conditions: a comparative analysis of 33 countries
items.title_en: Residential proximity to oil and gas development and socioeconomic conditions: a comparative analysis of 33 countries
items.title_zh: 居民区与油气开发项目的邻近程度及社会经济状况：33个国家的比较分析
items.summary_en: Fossil fuels continue to dominate the global energy supply. As emerging technologies drive up global energy consumption (e.g. cryptocurrency mining, data centers), identifying which populations live in residential proximity to oil and gas extraction will become increasingly important. Yet, no prior study has done so on an international scale. We combine the Oil and Gas Infrastructure Mapping database with the Global Human Settlement Layer to estimate residential proximity to oil and gas wells across 33 countries in 2024. We further link these data with indicators of income and social deprivation to examine disparities in population proximity. We estimate that 150.9 million people reside within 3 km of 4.5 million oil and gas wells across 33 countries, representing 10% of their population. Country-level residential proximity to oil and gas wells is highest in the Netherlands (38.4%), Canada (33.4%), and the United States (31.3%). Of the 33 countries, 15 had populations exposed to wells across borders, including 427 thousand Mexican residents near U.S. wells, and 185 thousand U.S. residents living near wells outside national borders. This is the first large-scale, multi-country quantification of residential exposure to oil and gas extraction, providing an evidence base for future population health research and policies to reduce risks and address energy-related inequities worldwide.
items.summary_zh: 化石燃料继续主导着全球能源供应。随着新兴技术（如加密货币挖矿、数据中心）推动全球能源消耗上升，确定哪些人群居住在石油和天然气开采区附近将变得越来越重要。然而，此前尚无研究在国际范围内开展过此类工作。 我们结合“油气基础设施测绘”数据库与“全球人类聚居层”数据，估算了2024年33个国家居民居住地与油气井的距离。 我们进一步将这些数据与收入和社会剥夺指标相结合，以考察人口居住地与油气井距离方面的差异。据估算，在这33个国家中，有1.509亿人居住在450万口油气井3公里范围内，占这些国家总人口的10%。 从国家层面看，居民与油气井的距离最近的国家依次是荷兰（38.4%）、加拿大（33.4%）和美国（31.3%）。 在这33个国家中，有15个国家的居民因跨国油气井而受到影响，其中包括42.7万名居住在美国油气井附近的墨西哥居民，以及18.5万名居住在境外油气井附近的美国居民。 这是首次针对石油和天然气开采导致的居民暴露风险进行的大规模、多国量化研究，为未来的人口健康研究以及旨在降低风险、解决全球能源相关不平等问题的政策提供了证据基础。

items.title: Unprecedented late-summer mega-heatwave over the Yangtze River Basin in 2024: dynamical fingerprint of extreme anomalous atmospheric circulation variability
items.title_en: Unprecedented late-summer mega-heatwave over the Yangtze River Basin in 2024: dynamical fingerprint of extreme anomalous atmospheric circulation variability
items.title_zh: 2024年长江流域夏季末史无前例的强热浪：极端异常大气环流变率的动力学特征
items.summary_en: Record-breaking heatwaves arise from the interplay between long-term warming and transient atmospheric circulation anomalies, yet the mechanisms by which atmospheric circulation variability contributes to unprecedented heatwave severity remain an active area of investigation. Here, we investigate the unprecedented late-summer 2024 super heatwave with concurrent dry conditions (LS24) over the Yangtze River Basin (YRB), which produced the largest late-summer temperature anomaly during 1979–2024. We show that the record-breaking magnitude of LS24 was primarily associated with an extreme realization of a recurrent Eurasian circulation mode superimposed on a warmer background. In the full-record Empirical Orthogonal Function analysis, the event coincided with the largest positive phase of the leading mode of late-summer Eurasian circulation variability, manifested as a trans-Eurasian Rossby wave train that established persistent East Asian ridging and a heat-dome environment over the YRB through enhanced subsidence, radiation, and moisture divergence. The constructed flow analog method partitions the 4.8 °C total anomaly into a 26%–29% long-term background, a 50%–57% circulation-associated component and a 17%–21% residual; the circulation component alone accounts for 71%–77% of the detrended anomaly. Seasonal forecast ensembles further show that the ensemble-mean response produced only modest warming and failed to reproduce the observed wave-train structure, whereas similar extreme circulation states emerged within member-to-member circulation variability and were associated with stronger YRB warming. These results highlight that, under a warming climate, rare atmospheric circulation extremes can strongly modulate regional heat severity under concurrent dry conditions and represent a fundamental challenge for seasonal prediction of unprecedented climate extremes.
items.summary_zh: 创纪录的热浪源于长期变暖与瞬态大气环流异常之间的相互作用，但大气环流变率如何导致前所未有的热浪强度，这一机制仍是当前研究的热点领域。 本文研究了2024年夏末长江流域（YRB）发生的一场伴有干旱条件的史无前例的超级热浪（LS24），该事件产生了1979–2024年间最大的夏末气温异常。 我们表明，LS24创纪录的强度主要与一种周期性出现的欧亚环流模态在变暖背景下的极端表现有关。在基于完整记录的经验正交函数分析中， 该事件恰与夏末欧亚环流变率主导模态的最大正相位重合，表现为一条横跨欧亚大陆的罗斯贝波列，该波列通过增强下沉、辐射和水汽散逸，在长江流域形成了持久的东亚高压脊和“热穹顶”环境。 通过构建的流场类比法，将4.8 °C的总异常值分解为26%–29%的长期背景、50%–57%的环流相关分量以及17%–21%的残差； 仅环流分量就占去趋势异常值的71%–77%。季节预报集合分析进一步表明，集合平均响应仅产生了温和的变暖，且未能再现观测到的波列结构；而成员间环流变异性中出现了类似的极端环流状态，并伴随着更强烈的YRB变暖。 这些结果强调，在气候变暖的背景下，罕见的大气环流极端事件在伴随干旱条件下会显著调节区域热浪强度，并为前所未有的气候极端事件的季节预报带来了根本性挑战。

items.summary_en: Nature Sustainability, Published online: 23 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41893-026-01979-5Turning water-based flow batteries into a truly sustainable technology hinges on recycling the organic molecules inside the battery. items.title: Increasing tropical forest fragmentation intensifies extreme high temperatures
items.title_en: Increasing tropical forest fragmentation intensifies extreme high temperatures
items.title_zh: 热带森林破碎化加剧导致极端高温现象加剧
items.summary_en: Deforestation, as one of the most pressing global environmental challenges, can intensify local temperature extremes through altering surface properties (e.g. albedo, roughness and evapotranspiration) and the associated land–atmosphere interactions. Prior studies have largely focused on the effects of forest cover changes at the grid scale, whereas the impact of subgrid-scale changes in forest fragmentation has received relatively limited attention. Utilizing satellite-based forest fragmentation index (FFI) data and the ERA5-Land reanalysis data, we investigate impacts of FFI changes in tropical forests on local extreme temperature indices, including the annual mean and maximum values of daily maximum temperature (TXm and TXx, respectively). Our results show that increasing FFI (i.e. forests becoming more fragmented) can significantly intensify extreme temperatures, with each unit increase in FFI corresponding to increases of 0.35 °C –1.14 °C for TXm and 0.83 °C –2.85 °C for TXx. These phenomena are mainly attributed to fragmentation-induced shifts in surface energy partitioning, which reduce latent heat flux and enhance sensible heating. The sensitivities of extreme temperatures to increasing FFI vary by region, with its strength being strongest in the Congo Basin (1.14 °C unit−1 for TXm and 2.85 °C unit−1 for TXx) but weaker in the Amazon basin (0.58 °C unit−1 for TXm and 1.21 °C unit−1 for TXx) and Southeast Asia (0.35 °C unit−1 for TXm and 0.83 °C unit−1 for TXx). These regional differences result from that background hydroclimatic conditions and land–atmosphere coupling strength can modulate the effect of forest fragmentation changes on extreme temperatures. These findings highlight the important role of increasing forest fragmentation in amplification of local temperature extremes, with implications for developing forest management strategies aimed at enhancing resilience to extreme climate events under ongoing warming.
items.summary_zh: 森林砍伐作为最紧迫的全球环境挑战之一，会通过改变地表特性（如反照率、粗糙度和蒸散量）以及相关的陆地-大气相互作用，加剧当地的极端气温。 先前的研究主要关注网格尺度上森林覆盖变化的影响，而亚网格尺度森林破碎化变化的影响则相对较少受到关注。 利用基于卫星的森林破碎化指数（FFI）数据和 ERA5-Land 再分析数据，我们研究了热带森林中 FFI 变化对当地极端温度指数的影响，包括日最高温度的年平均值和最大值（分别表示为 TXm 和 TXx）。 研究结果表明，FFI的增加（即森林破碎化程度加深）会显著加剧极端温度，FFI每增加一个单位，TXm和TXx分别上升0.35 °C–1.14 °C和0.83 °C –2.85 °C。这些现象主要归因于森林破碎化导致的地表能量分配变化，这种变化会降低潜热通量并增强显热加热。 极端温度对 FFI 增加的敏感性因地区而异，其中刚果盆地最为显著（TXm 为 1.14 °C/单位，TXx 为 2.85 °C/单位），而亚马逊盆地 （TXm 为 0.58 °C/单位，TXx 为 1.21 °C/单位）以及东南亚（TXm 为 0.35 °C/单位，TXx 为 0.83 °C/单位）则较弱。 这些区域差异源于背景水文气候条件和陆地-大气耦合强度能够调节森林破碎化变化对极端温度的影响。这些发现凸显了森林破碎化加剧在放大局部温度极端事件中的重要作用，这对制定旨在增强在持续变暖背景下应对极端气候事件韧性的森林管理策略具有重要意义。
